page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes. Running head above the text. Page number at the head. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot. Faint marks at the left and right edges are show-through or edge marks, not printed text.

main_text.p: Thermopylas contra Xerxem gestis clarissimum, patruus Pausaniæ, qui Mardonium cum Persis ad Platæas cecidit. Hic Cleomenes multarum tur-barum in Græcia concitator regnum suum aufpicatus est ab Argivis bello in-festandis: quos cum vastato agro in-genti strage inopinatos concidisset, & mox fuga in sacrum nemus delatos non pauciores quàm quinquies mille exer-citu undequaque clausos obsedisset, pri-mum L primores nominatim alios post alios per præconem tanquam de lytro secum transfacturos[?] è luco evocatos ve-lut victimas jugulavit: deinde reliquos omnes posthabita loci religione, nemo-re per Heilotas servos circum circa in-censos concremavit. Ab eo immani fa-cinore recta Argos propugnatoribus vacuum copias duxit: actumque de ci-vitate sine dubio fuisset, nisi una fœmi-na, eruditione celebris, & supra sexum fortis Telesilla obstitisset. Ea namque de adventu hostium certior facta in ex-tremo patriæ periculo, vocatis repente ad arma maribus, qui per ætatem bello non erant idonei, refixisque heic illic suspensis clypeis, ensibus, hastis ac telis aliis, & fœminis, quæ ætate ac viribus integræ erant, armatis, & secum ad mœnia ductis, qua hostes impressionem

page.notes: Faint marks along the left edge and a column of marks at the right edge (partly reading "illic", "ic") are show-through or edge marks from other pages, not printed text, and are left out. Page number read as 85; the final digit is uncertain. "transfacturos" is hard to read at the line break; the reading is doubtful. "ductis" is set with a ligature; read as ductis. The catchword "factur" is partly cut off. Printed spelling kept; the text runs on to the next page at "impressionem".
